import sys
import threading
from collections import defaultdict

sys.setrecursionlimit(1 << 25)
threading.stack_size(1 << 28)

def dfs(u, p, depth, parent, heavy, size, head, pos, cur_pos, tour):
    parent[u] = p
    depth[u] = depth[p] + 1
    size[u] = 1
    cur_heavy = -1
    for v, _ in adj[u]:
        if v == p:
            continue
        dfs(v, u, depth, parent, heavy, size, head, pos, cur_pos + size[v], tour)
        size[u] += size[v]
        if cur_heavy == -1 or size[v] > size[cur_heavy]:
            cur_heavy = v
    heavy[u] = cur_heavy
    head[u] = head[p] if heavy[p] != -1 and size[heavy[p]] >= size[u] else u
    pos[u] = cur_pos
    tour.append(u)

def build_lca(n, parent, depth):
    log_n = n.bit_length()
    lca = [[-1] * log_n for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        lca[i][0] = parent[i]
    for j in range(1, log_n):
        for i in range(n):
            if lca[i][j - 1] != -1:
                lca[i][j] = lca[lca[i][j - 1]][j - 1]
    return lca, log_n

def get_lca(u, v, lca, depth, log_n):
    if depth[u] < depth[v]:
        u, v = v, u
    diff = depth[u] - depth[v]
    for j in range(log_n):
        if diff & (1 << j):
            u = lca[u][j]
    if u == v:
        return u
    for j in range(log_n - 1, -1, -1):
        if lca[u][j] != lca[v][j]:
            u, v = lca[u][j], lca[v][j]
    return parent[u]

def query_dist(u, v, lca, depth):
    anc = get_lca(u, v, lca, depth, log_n)
    return depth[u] + depth[v] - 2 * depth[anc]

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    idx = 0
    n = int(input[idx])
    q = int(input[idx + 1])
    idx += 2
    a = list(map(int, input[idx:idx + n]))
    idx += n
    edges = []
    for _ in range(n - 1):
        u = int(input[idx]) - 1
        v = int(input[idx + 1]) - 1
        w = int(input[idx + 2])
        edges.append((u, v, w))
        adj[u].append((v, w))
        adj[v].append((u, w))
        idx += 3
    parent = [-1] * n
    depth = [0] * n
    heavy = [-1] * n
    size = [0] * n
    head = [0] * n
    pos = [0] * n
    tour = []
    dfs(0, 0, -1, parent, heavy, size, head, pos, 0, tour)
    lca, log_n = build_lca(n, parent, depth)
    ans = 0
    for _ in range(q):
        t = int(input[idx])
        idx += 1
        if t == 1:
            a_val = int(input[idx])
            b_val = int(input[idx + 1])
            v_val = int(input[idx + 2])
            idx += 3
            l = ((a_val ^ ans) % n) + 1
            r = ((b_val ^ ans) % n) + 1
            v = (v_val ^ ans) % n + 1
            if l > r:
                l, r = r, l
            u = a[pos[a[l - 1] - 1]]
            v = a[pos[a[r - 1] - 1]]
            ans = query_dist(u, v, lca, depth) + v
            print(ans)
        elif t == 2:
            a_val = int(input[idx])
            idx += 1
            x = ((a_val ^ ans) % (n - 1)) + 1
            a[x - 1], a[x] = a[x], a[x - 1]

adj = defaultdict(list)
threading.Thread(target=main).start()
